day_shape: 48 items: CENTCOM says USS Boxer enforcing US blockade of Iran with 105 vessels redirected, State Dept adds Saudi Arabia to major non-NATO ally list, JPost cites satellite imagery of Parchin/Taleghan 2 rebuild, heavy IRIB/Defa Press coverage of Basij 'Self-Sacrifice Exercise' in Tehran.

threads.label: US blockade and Iran war footing
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted that USS Boxer is conducting flight operations in the Arabian Sea in enforcement of the US blockade against Iran, saying 105 commercial vessels have been redirected as of Sept 18. IRIB amplified a CNBC item on US diesel at $6.31/gallon and a Foreign Policy piece arguing America is losing its war with Iran; JPost previewed Trump's UNGA appearance touting the Iran campaign.

threads.label: Basij 'Self-Sacrifice Exercise' in Tehran
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran extensive coverage of a large-scale Basij 'Self-Sacrifice Exercise' held in Greater Tehran with the president and Sepah Muhammad Rasul Allah commander present. Iran International framed the same event as an IRGC show of force two days after the 2022 protest anniversary, with paraded volunteers, Basij and children.

threads.label: Yemen: Saudi proposal, Red Sea displacement
threads.summary: JPost reported Saudi Arabia has conveyed a proposal via Oman to the Houthis for a two-week ceasefire and direct Riyadh–Houthi talks, and cited UN figures of 112,000 people displaced inside Yemen in two weeks. Yemen's Yahya Saree said Saudi 'ISIS-character' activities in Sana'a had been foiled, and Defa Press reported a million-strong pro-armed-forces march in Saada.

threads.label: Iran postwar economy and domestic pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported officials publicly acknowledging household hardship and said Iran has lost about a third of pre-war gas production capacity heading into winter. Tehran's mayor Zakani said the government and municipality had agreed to cut and freeze some essential-goods prices for six months from 5 Mehr.

threads.label: Nuclear site rebuild and arms-export rules
threads.summary: JPost cited satellite imagery showing Iran rapidly rebuilding the Taleghan 2 facility at Parchin, struck by Israel in 2024 and again in March 2026 during Operation Roaring Lion. The State Department published an ITAR rule adding Saudi Arabia and Peru to the major non-NATO ally list and clarifying policy-of-denial provisions.

events.title_en: CNBC: The consequences of unprecedented diesel prices will spread throughout the US economy within weeks. Since the beginning of the war with Iran in early this year, American drivers have been watching petrol prices with concern, and now diesel prices have reached an unprecedented mark of $6.31 per gallon.
events.summary_en: CNBC: The consequences of unprecedented diesel prices will spread throughout the US economy within weeks. Since the beginning of the war with Iran in early this year, American drivers have been watching petrol prices with concern, and now diesel prices have reached an unprecedented mark of $6.31 per gallon. If unprecedented prices continue, what started with truckers and railway companies will ultimately weigh on consumers' shoulders. The longer diesel prices remain high, the broader the list of goods and services affected by it will become; to the extent that food prices, delivery costs and other seasonal goods are likely to be affected.
